data.description:
Procurement and supply chain is a $3 trillion market still running on outdated systems and manual processes. Magentic is changing that.

We’re building a new generation of agentic AI that works inside the world’s largest and most complex organisations, backed by Sequoia and built by a team from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey. We’re early, moving fast and already solving real problems for global enterprises.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll be at the heart of making that happen. You’ll take what we build and turn it into real-world impact for our customers, owning engagements from initial scoping through to live deployment.

You’ll sit at the intersection of product, commercial and customer, figuring out what needs to be built, how we make it work and how we deliver meaningful outcomes. You won’t just be deploying Magentic, you’ll help shape how we work with customers as we scale.

What You’ll Do

You’ll have a huge impact on both Magentic’s commercial success and our product direction. This is a rare opportunity to help build a rocket ship. As we grow, you could develop into product management or engineering, into a leader in our customer engineering space, even into sales, as you discover your strengths and interests.

  • Own deployments end-to-end—design the rollout strategy at household-name enterprises, run the programme, and change course decisively when the approach isn't landing.

  • Hold the senior relationships—be the Director and VP sponsor's first call, run steering governance, and take on the difficult conversations.

  • Find the value nobody has scoped—go looking beyond the signed scope, prove new use cases with the customer, and build the case for what we sell them next.

  • Define best practice for AI deployment—set the bar on your deployments, and turn this into processes that the rest of the org can use to scale.

  • Shape our roadmap—bring product and engineering the problem, the customer evidence, and a view on what we should build.

You Might Be a Great Fit if You

  • Have 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing delivery or product role

  • Have managed complex, multi-stakeholder projects at senior levels and kept them moving when priorities shifted

  • Think commercially: you track outcomes, not just activities, and you understand how successful deployments translate into revenue

  • Are energised by early-stage ambiguity — you can create structure where none exists and make decisions with incomplete information

  • Communicate exceptionally well, both in the room with a VP and in a written handover to a colleague

Bonus Points

  • Have experience deploying AI, automation, or data products inside large organisations

  • Are familiar with procurement, supply chain, or finance functions in enterprise settings

Compensation and Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £100-110k

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown

  • In-office lunches provided

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Hybrid London HQ (WFH Thurs and every other Tues, with flex if you have appointments etc)

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

  3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Responsible AI Statement

At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

Magentic is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, or any other basis as protected by the Equality Act 2010.

We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and cultures and believe a diverse workforce enhances our ability to deliver innovative solutions. We also ensure that our employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Magentic is dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please indicate this in your application or contact us directly.

Mechanical Design Engineer – Product Development

Location:
Concept House, Brackenbeck Road, Bradford, BD7 2LW

Reports To:
Technical Manager

Salary:
Salary is negotiable and will reflect the successful candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications.

Job Purpose

Debar designs and manufactures bifold door hardware and complete bifold door systems for customers in the UK and international markets. As we invest in future growth and an expanding product pipeline, we are creating a new Mechanical Design Engineer position within our Technical Engineering team.

Our development work follows two complementary routes: collaborating with external systems houses and industry partners to create hardware solutions for their door systems; and developing Debar's own proprietary or white-label bifold and other system solutions for selected global markets.

The role may support either or both routes. The successful candidate will take mechanical components and assemblies from concept through detailed design, prototyping, testing and production, while contributing technical expertise in discussions with customers and partners where required.

Our products integrate precision hardware with aluminium profiles, so sound judgement around tolerances, fit, movement, materials and manufacturing methods is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Product & System Development

  • Design and develop mechanical components, assemblies and product concepts for bifold door hardware and systems, together with other products as required.
  • Work with systems houses, fabricators and industry partners to understand technical requirements and develop hardware solutions that integrate effectively with their systems.
  • Design and develop Debar’s proprietary and white-label bifold and other system solutions for introduction into appropriate global markets.
  • Create accurate 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, specifications and Bills of Materials.
  • Take designs from initial concept through detailed engineering, prototype, testing, validation and production release.
  • Consider how hardware interacts with aluminium profiles and the complete door system, including alignment, movement, adjustment, load transfer and long-term performance.
  • Carry out tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups to achieve reliable fit, function and manufacturability.
  • Undertake appropriate engineering calculations and analysis to substantiate design decisions and product performance.
  • Contribute ideas for future products and provide practical engineering input into product and system opportunities.

Manufacture, Testing & Engineering Control

  • Apply Design for Manufacture and Assembly (DFM/DFA) principles across relevant processes including machining, extrusion, die casting, injection moulding, pressing and mechanical assembly.
  • Work with Production, Quality and the wider Supply Chain to resolve manufacturing, tooling, quality and cost considerations.
  • Support prototype builds, product testing and the structured investigation of issues arising during development and product launch.
  • Maintain drawing revisions and engineering change records, ensuring design changes are controlled and validated.
  • Improve and value-engineer existing products without compromising performance or quality.
  • Refine and value-engineer products during development and launch without compromising performance or quality.

Technical & Partner Collaboration

  • Communicate technical concepts, design decisions and development progress clearly to colleagues, customers, system partners and suppliers.
  • Translate commercial, customer or system requirements into practical, manufacturable engineering solutions.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Degree, HND or equivalent recognised higher-level qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a closely related discipline. A relevant formal qualification is mandatory and experience alone will not be accepted as an alternative.
  • Relevant professional experience in mechanical design, product design or product development engineering.
  • Strong capability in parametric 3D CAD and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.
  • Experience designing physical products or components for manufacture rather than CAD modelling alone.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical engineering, materials and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong understanding of Design for Manufacture, dimensional tolerances, engineering fits and tolerance stack-up analysis.
  • Methodical mechanical problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to progress defined engineering work independently while contributing effectively to a wider team.
  • Confidence communicating technical information with customers and partners.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Fenestration, windows, doors, aluminium architectural systems or other moving door systems.
  • Mechanical or architectural hardware such as hinges, rollers, guides, handles or locks.
  • Small precision components involving aluminium extrusions, castings, mouldings or CNC-machined parts.
  • Product testing, New Product Introduction, value engineering, tooling or supplier development.
  • Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred; experienced SolidWorks, Creo or comparable CAD users will also be considered. AutoCAD and ERP experience would be beneficial.

Direct experience designing bifold door hardware or systems would be particularly valuable but is not an essential requirement.

Attributes

  • Practical, curious and interested in how mechanical products and systems work.
  • Able to balance product performance, manufacturability, quality and cost.
  • Credible and confident in technical discussions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborative, self-motivated and comfortable taking ownership of defined projects.
  • Enthusiastic about joining a business investing in product development and future growth.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, permanent role based primarily at Debar’s Bradford facility, with one day per week homeworking currently available.
  • Occasional travel may be required for supplier visits, product trials, customer projects or testing.

data.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou

combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers.

Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du

projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/

MISSIONS

Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes :

  1. Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de

fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes

que les modèles acquièrent.

3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet.

ACTIVITÉS :

  1. Critères de diversité dans les représentations :

• Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de

fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables.

• Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus

ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus

compacte que la seule importance individuelle.

• Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les

profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues.

2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes :

• Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des

modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement.

• Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les

mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation.

• Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en

particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

3. Production scientifique et vie du projet :

• Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales.

• Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats.


Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

🎓 Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d'embauche, en apprentissage automatique, informatique, traitement du signal ou mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

✔️ Solide maîtrise de l'apprentissage profond et de ses fondements mathématiques.

✔️ Pratique courante de Python et d'un cadre d'apprentissage profond, PyTorch de préférence.

✔️ Expérience de travail sur des architectures de type transformer, et capacité à instrumenter leurs représentations internes.

✔️ Autonomie dans la conduite d'expériences sur GPU, y compris sur une infrastructure de calcul partagée.

🇬🇧 Publications dans des conférences ou revues internationales du domaine, et très bon niveau d'anglais scientifique, écrit comme oral.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

✨ Connaissance de l'interprétabilité mécaniste : autoencodeurs parcimonieux, sondes linéaires, analyse de circuits.

✨ Familiarité avec les processus ponctuels déterminantaux, ou plus généralement avec les méthodes d'échantillonnage et l'algèbre linéaire aléatoire.

✨ Intérêt pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

✨ Expérience du calcul distribué multi-GPU et d'un ordonnanceur de type SLURM.

Capacités et aptitudes :

✔️ Autonomie scientifique et goût pour les questions ouvertes, le poste comportant une part exploratoire assumée.

✔️ Rigueur expérimentale et attention portée à la reproductibilité.

✔️ Goût du travail collectif : le poste est en interaction directe avec plusieurs doctorants du projet.

✔️ Qualités rédactionnelles, et capacité à présenter des résultats à un public non spécialiste.

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES

• La maîtrise du français n'est pas requise : l'anglais est la langue de travail de l'équipe dès qu'un de ses membres n'est pas francophone.

• Les publications issues du projet sont déposées

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE :

L'un de nos principaux enjeux est de lever les barrières à l'entrée et de proposer une expérience utilisateur fluide et engageante, capable de renforcer l'attractivité de notre application et de maximiser la rétention des nouveaux utilisateurs.

  • Découvrir toutes les étapes de conception d'un produit digital, de l'idée jusqu'à sa mise entre les mains de plusieurs centaines de milliers de joueurs.

Au fil du stage, tu seras donc progressivement intégré au processus de définition et de pilotage de nos projets produits. Cette montée en compétence te conduira à ton projet de fin de stage : repenser et optimiser l'expérience d'accueil et d'intégration du nouveau joueur.

Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.
 
Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+2 minimum dans le domaine du graphisme, du design visuel ou de la 3D, tu justifies d’une double sensibilité 2D/3D.

Tes outils de prédilections :

  • Maîtrise d’un logiciel 3D : en interne, nous utilisons Cinema 4D, mais si tu maîtrises Blender ou Maya ton profil nous intéresse également
  • Maîtrise indispensable des logiciels de PAO de la suite Adobe : Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign.

    • Les qualités et compétences requises pour ce poste :

  • L’organisation, savoir gérer ton temps entre la modélisation / rendu 3D et les déclinaisons graphiques rapides, le tout dans des délais parfois serrés.
  • Avoir une bonne capacité d’écoute et être capable d’analyser les informations données
  • Être force de proposition pour proposer des concepts visuels forts, de la modélisation d’objets à la création d’environnements complets
  • Avoir une bonne culture graphique
  • Esprit d’équipe
  • Bonne maîtrise des outils IA
  • Connaissances/compétences appréciées : Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro (pour donner vie à tes rendus 3D en motion design)
  • Intérêt pour l’univers de poker/betting/gaming

    • MODALITÉS ASSOCIÉES AU POSTE
  • Poste à pourvoir en CDI temps plein (35h/semaine) exclusivement
  • Semaine en 4 jours
  • Lieu de travail : Paris intra-muros
  • Date de démarrage : ASAP
  • Rémunération selon le profil
  • Modalités de travail exclues : mi-temps, freelance, job étudiant, contrat en alternance

    • PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT
    Nous vous prions de bien vouloir joindre un portfolio à votre candidature ; cette étape est obligatoire. Toute candidature reçue sans portfolio sera refusée.
  • Screening RH
  • Test
  • Entretien avec Romain et Lucille

    • Afin de garantir une expérience candidat optimale, les processus de recrutement chez Winamax durent, en moyenne, entre 2 et 4 semaines.

    POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?
     
    En plus de notre univers poker et paris sportifs, nous avons d’autres avantages !
     
    • Une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique 
    • Une semaine de travail en 4 jours pour la majorité de nos équipes
    • Un cadre de travail convivial, en plein cœur de Paris (rooftop tour Eiffel, salle de jeux vidéo et salle de sport…)
    • Des possibilités de mobilité interne 
    • Une vie d’entreprise riche avec des soirées et événements organisés régulièrement (tournois de poker, soirées thématiques, barbecues tout l'été…)
    • Des primes d’intéressement et de participation 
    • Un accès au programme de cooptation (bonus de cooptation jusqu’à 5000 €)
    • Un restaurant d’entreprise (ou panier repas)
    • Une excellente mutuelle
    • 6 semaines de congés payés

data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP

⭐️ Operations at Alan

The Operations Community’s core responsibilities is to deliver at scale our insurance and health services : we build our platform and operational capabilities and run our processes to guarantee delight and efficiency.

As we anchor our Insurance position, diversify our offering with health and well-being related services in 4 different countries (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada), our operations are increasingly complex and our challenges ahead have never been as exciting!

Being an Ops at Alan means joining a team of 50+ talented, committed and passionate Ops across our countries, with a lot of interactions with Engineering, Product, Care and many other teams at Alan.

We have a mix of Builder profiles, focused on (re)designing and implementing our processes and Operations Coordinators who deliver those on a daily basis while improving them.

We want team members to deliver excellence to our companies and members and be ready to disrupt (and not only upgrade) the way we traditionally think about insurance or healthcare services.

Want to learn more about Ops at Alan? Read how we work and hire and watch our team in action

 

📍Join Alan’s Operations team in Lyon

The Operations Coordinator works on a specific subset of services we deliver (eg. claim reimbursement, fraud, clinic to name a few) .

Their core responsibilities (+- 70/80% of the time) are to:

  • Run our Insurance or Health services processes - that's why we call them Ops Runners internally 😉

  • Ensure the day-to-day follow up and monitoring of our operations

  • Flag risks and opportunities

In details, your missions are:

  • Operating our processes: performing tasks like invoicing or claims treatment, growing and managing our network of providers, supporting internal teams (live and through documentation)

  • Contributing to the definition & owning the best monitoring scheme to track volumes/efficiency/SLAs, and identify risks and areas of improvement, internally or with our service providers

  • Supervising partnerships (e.g. teleconsultation, claim operators), participating in the negotiation rounds, daily communication to ensure business continuity

  • Performing controls on our daily operations to make sure the correct decisions were made and to identify training needs (internally as well as externally)

  • Escalating feedback, helping to prioritise and supporting initiatives to make our processes and services more delightful and efficient

Next to running and monitoring our operations, you implement continuous improvements to our processes (+-20/30% of the time). This can be in a variety of ways, e.g. working with product teams to automate certain processes, enhancing our external communication, auditing our processes, automating some process steps using automation tools, …

⭐️ Our Run organisation ⭐️

Our Operations Coordinators or Ops Runners are organized in pools (3-7 runners) who are collectively responsible for running their scope. Examples of topics are:

Alan therapy: members can book a therapy session with psychologists. You maintain smooth relationships with our psychologists, ensure therapy demand  matches the supply and contribute to several steps of their lifecycle at Alan (hiring, onboarding, invoicing, supporting booking management etc).

Claims: We provide a best-in-class claims experience, including our own optic care service. You treat claims and assist in decisions regarding our coverage. Additionally, you monitor the performance of external service providers to meet SLAs & perform quality controls. You ensure glasses get delivered on time, member satisfaction is high, our frame collection is attractive, collaboration with opticians is smooth and efficient, ….

Fraud: We run checks on claims submitted by our members, and build new ways of preventing fraud attempts. You investigate suspicious claims, prevent fraudulent payments or recover when we paid fraudulent claims.

Set up:  We provide best-in-class experience to our Customers : a smooth on/offboarding of their employees and a seamless invoicing or billing. To do so, we continuously control & improve the quality of our processes : ensuring we have consistent information for invoicing, unlocking employee invite/removals in case of issue and supporting admin in case of payment issue or bankruptcy.

Note: We look for profiles able to embrace any challenge and jump in any pool ! Depending on Alan needs (and personal interests), an Operations Coordinator will join in a pool and  can change and explore new scopes after some time. Do not hesitate to ask more concrete examples to the Operations Team Members you’ll meet during the process so they can share about their own scope.

⭐️ Experience ⭐️

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Since the scope of our Ops Runner role is extremely varied, we are open to candidates from different backgrounds : you could be a good fit for the Operations team at Alan if, for example, you:

  • Operated processes and services especially for companies during the scale up stage or in industrial/logistic industries

  • Worked in Support functions (Customer Support, People Operations etc)

  • Had a Customer facing Commercial experience, e.g. account manager or Customer Success Communications, such as Social Media, Internal/ External Communications

  • Handled event coordination

⭐️ Skills ⭐️

  • Passionate about delivering & optimizing top notch operations: not scared to get your hands dirty to get into technical processes, making them clear and delightful for our operators and members

  • A keen problem-solver and challenger with a dig deep mindset: what drives you is member and customer satisfaction !

  • Analytics skills, to be able to dive into our data

  • Highly organised with exceptional follow-up skills, with strong attention to details

  • Strong and structured in written and verbal communication in English as well as in French or Dutch

  • Able to work and learn independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Adaptable: you show flexibility and a strong ability to adapt to variable situations

  • It’s even better if you have experience in the insurance or the healthcare industry

🙌  Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands.

 

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

You’ll work hands-on, shipping production integrations. As the integration surface grows, you’ll shape the architecture, standards, and processes that keep integration work scalable.

 
 

What you'll do

Build integrations that unlock Luna’s next capabilities

  • Design and implement read/write integrations into third-party practice management systems

  • Design infrastructure that scales to hundreds of thousands of individual practice servers

  • Engineer reliability into the system: data consistency, idempotency, retries, error handling, observability

  • Triage integration failures in production, communicate impact clearly, and harden the system so the same class of failure doesn’t repeat

Make integration a scalable capability

  • Define technical standards and architecture for integrations

  • Establish pragmatic processes for development, maintenance, and incident handling

 

What we're looking for

Must-have

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, TypeScript and/or Rust

  • Proven experience building and running software in production

  • Strong understanding of integration patterns, distributed systems, and failure modes

  • Comfort operating in messy environments (inconsistent behavior, missing docs, etc.)

  • Clear communication under pressure (during incidents, vendor issues, competing priorities)

  • Excited to work in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-have

  • Prior work on healthcare software or practice management systems

  • Familiarity with healthcare workflows, terminology, or data standards (e.g. FHIR)

  • Fluent German (spoken and written)

  • Experience in startups or scale-ups

 

Location & compensation

  • Location: Remote

  • Compensation: Competitive salary and participation in our VSOP program

  • Team bonding: Regular get-togethers, happy hours and offsites

  • Health and productivity: Urban Sports Club subscription

 

If you want to shape the next generation of healthcare software with us, apply now.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

Who we are:

Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

Our culture:

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, Toronto, and São Paulo. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere

  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

About the role:

Sales Engineering is a team of subject matter experts who serve as the trusted technical advisor to prospective customers. Internally, your insights from the field will help shape our product roadmap and will pave the way for future customers. You will play a key role in our commitment to customer excellence and allow Sardine to stay ahead of market trends.

At the intersection of our Go-To-Market and Product and Engineering teams, we serve as the link between our customer’s needs and the Sardine’s capabilities, ensuring our platform is always adding value to our customer’s Fraud and Compliance stack. Présentation département

L’Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon (INL) a pour vocation de développer des recherches technologiques multidisciplinaires dans le domaine des micro et nanotechnologies et de leurs applications. Les recherches menées s’étendent des matériaux aux systèmes. Le laboratoire s’appuie sur la plate-forme technologique lyonnaise Nanolyon.

Les domaines d’application couvrent de grands secteurs économiques : l’industrie des semiconducteurs, les technologies de l’information, les technologies du vivant et de la santé, l’énergie et l’environnement.

Le laboratoire est multi sites avec des localisations sur les campus d’Ecully et de Lyon-Tech La Doua. Il regroupe environ 240 personnes dont 120 personnels permanents. L’INL est un acteur majeur du Pôle de Recherche et d’Enseignement.

Ce poste se situe dans un environnement innovant, à la pointe des technologies du futur, dans des secteurs stratégiques applicatifs.

Le poste se situe dans un secteur relevant de la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique (PPST), et nécessite donc, conformément à la réglementation, que votre arrivée soit autorisée par l'autorité compétente du MESR

Présentation de la ou les thématiques :

Le programme PHOENIX est un projet national d’envergure (17 M€, 5 ans) financé par France 2030 et visant à structurer un hub français pour la conception de circuits intégrés, incluant les chiplets et les méthodes d’EDA enrichies par l’IA. Il implique plusieurs laboratoires du CNRS (INL, TIMA, IRISA, IETR, LIP6, LIRMM, LAMIH, IMS, Lab Hubert Curien, Lab-STICC…), le CEA-LIST, ainsi que de nombreux partenaires académiques et industriels.

Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) ingénieur(e) informatique / EDA chargé(e) de la qualification des outils, modèles et blocs IP utilisés et développés au sein de PHOENIX, en interaction étroite avec les équipes de recherche, les doctorants et les partenaires industriels.

Description de la ou les missions / les activités

- Mettre en place, maintenir et faire évoluer l’environnement logiciel de conception (flow EDA) pour les partenaires du consortium PHOENIX (CAO, simulation, caractérisation, PDK, IP).
- Qualifier les outils EDA (commercials et open source), modèles de dispositifs et blocs IP : définition de bancs de tests, métriques de performance, protocoles d’évaluation et rapports de validation.
- Participer à l’intégration et à l’évaluation de méthodes d’EDA augmentées par l’IA (optimisation de flows, génération de modèles, analyse automatique de résultats, etc.).
- Assurer le support technique auprès des équipes (installation, configuration, troubleshooting, interface avec les fournisseurs d’outils et les équipes IT locales).
- Contribuer à la rédaction de livrables techniques du projet : documents de spécification, rapports de qualification, guides d’utilisation des outils et IP.
- Mettre en place de bonnes pratiques pour la gestion de versions, la traçabilité des résultats, l’automatisation des flows (scripts, CI/CD, conteneurisation).
- Participer à la veille technologique sur les outils EDA, les librairies IP, les technologies de calcul avancées et proposer des évolutions du parc logiciel.



Profil recherché / Compétences attendues________________________________

Diplômes : Diplôme d’ingénieur, Master 2 ou doctorat en informatique, microélectronique ou domaine proche.
Expérience : Débutant accepté

Compétences opérationnelles :

- Solides compétences en EDA (front-end et/ou back-end) : RTL, synthèse, P&R, extraction, simulation (SPICE, mixed-signal, etc.), PDK, caractérisation.
- Maîtrise de scripts et automatisation (Python, Shell, Make, ou équivalent) et aisance avec les environnements Linux.
- Connaissance souhaitée des architectures matérielles pour l’IA, des technologies émergentes ou de la conception de chiplets.
- Intérêt marqué pour la qualité logicielle et la validation : tests, métriques, reproductibilité, documentation.
- Excellent sens de la communication et du travail en équipe dans un environnement multi-sites et pluridisciplinaire.
- Maîtrise du français et bonne pratique de l’anglais technique (échanges avec partenaires et fournisseurs, rédaction de rapports).
 

Contexte de travail / Environnement de travail_______________________________

- Localisation principale : Ecole Centrale de Lyon (Ecully, Lyon), avec déplacements ponctuels sur les sites partenaires.

data.description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

  • Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into architecture simulators, enabling design space exploration across the full heterogeneous system.

  • Investigate hardware/software co-design strategies for mapping real-world applications — particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and signal processing kernels — onto the ternary IMC fabric, exploiting approximate computing techniques to trade precision for energy efficiency.

  • Assess and benchmark the energy, performance, and accuracy trade-offs of ternary IMC against binary CMOS and binary NVM-based IMC reference implementations, using both synthetic benchmarks and real application workloads.

  • Contribute to the definition of a design methodology for ternary ferroelectric circuits, including EDA tool flows, cell library characterization guidelines, and design rules, with the aim of enabling broader community adoption.


Required Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate holds a PhD in microelectronics, computer architecture, or a closely related field, and demonstrates at least one of the following hard skills:

  • Circuit and architecture design: Strong expertise in digital circuit design flows and computer architecture, with hands-on experience using industrial EDA tools (Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre, Synopsys). Experience with standard-cell library characterization is a plus.

  • Emerging memory technologies: Solid knowledge of non-volatile memory devices, preferably including ferroelectric materials (FeFET, FeCap) or resistive memories (RRAM, PCM). Familiarity with compact modeling is an asset.

  • System-level design and simulation: Experience with architecture-level simulation frameworks and hardware/software co-design methodologies. Knowledge of RISC-V ecosystems is a plus.

  • Application domains: Familiarity with deep neural network inference workloads and/or digital signal processing pipelines, particularly in the context of approximate or energy-constrained computing.

  • Programming: Proficiency in HDL (Verilog, VHDL, Verilog-A) and scripting languages (Python, Shell) for design automation and simulation.

Soft skills: Scientific leadership, ability to coordinate with PhD students and international partners, strong publication record consistent with career stage, and excellent written and oral communication in English.

Language: Fluent scientific English is mandatory. French is not required but is welcome.

data.description:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide. From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You’ll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation.

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.

  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.

  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.

Du bist mehr als Schnittstelle: Du erkennst, was eine Marke jetzt braucht, übersetzt es in klare Social-Maßnahmen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Systeme, die langfristig Relevanz aufbauen und Wachstum ermöglichen.


Das erwartet dich:

  • Strategisches Account Management: Du führst Kund:innen eigenständig auf Senior-Level, berätst sie zur ganzheitlichen Full-Social-Präsenz und baust langfristige Partnerschaften auf.
  • Strategische und operative Steuerung: Du übersetzt Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Aktivierungspläne und priorisierte To-dos – auch über mehrere Projekte hinweg.
  • Channel Ownership: Du entwickelst plattformgerechte Strategien und stellst sicher, dass Inhalte zu Marke, Zielgruppe, Community und Plattformlogik passen.
  • Projekt-, Produktions- und Content-Steuerung: Du verantwortest Social-Aktivierungen, Redaktionsplanung und Produktionen von der Konzeption bis zur Freigabe. Dabei sicherst du markenkonsistenten, plattformnativen Content mit klarer Wirkungserwartung.
  • Creator- und Community-Management: Du steuerst Creator-Kooperationen ganzheitlich – von Auswahl und Verhandlung bis zu Briefing und Auswertung. Community-Learnings und kulturelle Signale übersetzt du in relevante Empfehlungen.
  • Performance-, Budget- und Paid-Media-Kompetenz: Du interpretierst Daten, leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab, steuerst Budgets und Wirtschaftlichkeit und integrierst Paid Media in deine Full-Funnel-Beratung.
  • Fachliches Sparring und Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst Standards für Creator Management, Measurement und AI-gestützte Prozesse weiter, bringst dein Wissen ins Team ein und stärkst Strategie- und Creative-Kompetenz.


Das bringst du mit:

Das sind deine Kernkompetenzen

  • Du kannst komplexe Marken- und Business-Ziele in klare Social-Strategien, Prioritäten und umsetzbare Pläne übersetzen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung anspruchsvoller Kund:innenetats oder Retainer – von Beratung und Planung bis Umsetzung, Performance-Review und Weiterentwicklung.

  • Du beherrschst Full Social: Plattformstrategie, Content-Systeme, Community, Creator und Paid Media gehören für dich zu einer wirksamen Markenführung zusammen.

  • Du steuerst Projekte, Budgets, Aufwände und Stakeholder vorausschauend und kannst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge in klare Entscheidungen übersetzen.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung im Creator Management mit – inklusive Auswahl, Verhandlung, Briefing, Steuerung, Qualitätskontrolle und Auswertung.

  • Du kannst Daten und Reportings analytisch einordnen, strategische Implikationen ableiten und Handlungsempfehlungen klar vermitteln.

  • Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Marken, Content und Plattformkultur und kannst kreative Qualität konstruktiv, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe führen.


So arbeitest du

  • Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch sowie sicher auf Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und proaktiv – auch wenn sich Prioritäten, Plattformen oder Anforderungen verändern.

  • Du erkennst früh, wo Abstimmung oder Steuerung nötig ist, und handelst entsprechend – mit Kund:innen, Creator:innen und im Team.

  • Du hältst strategische Prioritäten auch bei hohem Tempo im Blick und schaffst Orientierung, wenn viele Themen gleichzeitig laufen.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Wissen zu teilen, Kolleg:innen fachlich zu sparren und Arbeitsweisen gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.


Das bekommst du bei uns:

Flexibilität mit Verbindung

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit unserem Office in Hamburg als Team-Hub

  • Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat gemeinsames Arbeiten im Office für integrierte Teamarbeit

  • Flexibles Arbeiten von zuhause und wenn du Lust auf einen Perspektivwechsel hast, nach Absprache zeitweise aus dem Ausland

  • Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine Arbeitsweise, die zu deinem Alltag passt

  • Freie Wahl deiner Hardware


Benefits, die dir wirklich etwas bringen

  • Gemeinsame Events und Workations, weil gute Zusammenarbeit nicht nur im Kalender entsteht

  • Wahlweise Zuschuss zum ÖPNV-Ticket, Probonio-Gutschein oder Urban Sports Club

  • Bagel-Frühstück im Office für einen gemeinsamen Start in den Tag


Und sonst?

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen in deine Expertise

  • Raum, eine wachsende Agentur und unsere Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitzugestalten

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf zwei Jahre befristet – mit Option auf Verlängerung bzw. Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis.

Dann bewirb dich über unser Karriereportal:

https://wecreate-germany-gmbh.jobs.personio.de/

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Supply Chain Data & Operations Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Supply Planning à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027.

Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). 

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Supply Planning, vos principales missions seront :

1. Opérationnel & optimisation

  • Piloter les flux de rebalancing de stock entre nos entrepôts en interface directe avec nos partenaires logistiques internationaux 
  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la qualité de nos données opérationnelles en proposant une meilleure lecture / compréhension de la performance : un levier clé pour affiner nos prévisions de ventes et de commandes 
  • Participer à l'amélioration continue des processus de l'équipe Supply Planning
  • Contribuer aux analyses ad-hoc de l’équipe (non exhaustif : étude positionnement prix, taux de retour, évolution des écoulements, impact mix géographique etc.). 

2. Projet fil rouge : dashboard de performance opérationnelle / performance planning

Tout au long du stage, vous piloterez la création d'un outil centralisé de suivi de notre performance opérationnelle / performance planning :

  • Cadrer et concevoir : définir les KPI clés liés aux besoins métier et choisir la solution technique adaptée.
  • Structurer la donnée : identifier les sources et automatiser les flux de données pour garantir la fiabilité et la robustesse de l’outil.
  • Tester et déployer : votre objectif principal sera d’assurer l’adoption de votre outil aux processus métier.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en école d'ingénieur, de commerce ou d'université avec une spécialisation en Supply Chain, et recherchez un stage de césure ou de fin d’études de 6 mois
  • Vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, organisée et curieuse
  • Vous maîtrisez impérativement Excel
  • Vous êtes proactif(ve) et possédez un bon esprit analytique 
  • Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe, l’envie de partager et développer vos compétences dans un environnement agile et dynamique

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

Votre Rôle

Au sein de l'équipe B2B France, vous êtes responsable de construire et de développer une expérience forte et cohérente pour notre réseau de professionnels de santé, en particulier à travers les congrès, événements, formations et autres opportunités d’interaction .

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les Regional Managers afin d’identifier les opportunités du terrain et de construire une stratégie événementielle permettant de maximiser la qualité et l’impact de ces interactions.

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d’acquisition et d’expérience événementielle B2B en identifiant les congrès, événements, formations, webinars et autres opportunités d’interaction avec les professionnels de santé, et en construisant un calendrier annuel cohérent avec les objectifs de l'entreprise

  • Piloter l’organisation et la préparation des congrès et événements en coordonnant les différents interlocuteurs internes et externes afin de créer une expérience professionnelle et cohérente pour les participants

  • Développer des formats d’expérience et d’interaction adaptés aux professionnels de santé, notamment des formations, workshops, webinars, petits-déjeuners ou événements régionaux, en fonction des besoins identifiés sur le terrain

  • Maximiser l’acquisition et la conversion en collaborant avec les Regional Managers afin d'identifier les besoins d’activation du réseau, transformer les besoins communs en initiatives scalables et assurer la continuité entre événement, activation et suivi

  • Construire une expérience professionnelle différenciante en concevant le parcours du professionnel avant, pendant et après l’événement afin de renforcer son engagement envers Sunday Natural

  • Mesurer et optimiser la performance en analysant la participation, la qualité des leads, les conversions, l’engagement et le ROI afin d’identifier les événements les plus performants

Votre Profil

  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation avec orientation scientifique (nutrition, biologie, santé ou domaine similaire) et vous disposez d’une première expérience en marketing, événementiel ou gestion de projet

  • Vous avez une bonne capacité à comprendre et vulgariser des sujets scientifiques et êtes à l’aise pour échanger sur des thématiques scientifiques avec différents interlocuteurs

  • Vous êtes organisé(e), autonome et avez de solides compétences en gestion de projet et coordination, avec la capacité de gérer plusieurs événements et parties prenantes simultanément

  • Vous avez une approche orientée business et savez évaluer la pertinence d’une opportunité, prioriser les investissements et mesurer leur impact

  • Vous aimez travailler de manière transverse avec les équipes commerciales, marketing, Brand et Product et êtes capable de transformer les besoins du terrain en expériences pertinentes et scalables

  • Vous parlez couramment français et anglais (à l'écrit comme à l'oral). Ce poste est basé dans nos bureaux à Paris.

À noter : L'anglais étant notre langue d'entreprise, la communication avec le siège ainsi que les premiers entretiens se dérouleront en anglais

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une réduction attractive sur l'ensemble de nos produits - des huiles essentielles aux vitamines et nutriments.

  • 25 jours de congés payés par an, complétés par jusqu'à 5 jours de repos offerts entre Noël et le Nouvel An.

  • Parce que les plus belles réussites naissent des rencontres, nous adoptons un modèle hybride avec un jour de télétravail par semaine (jusqu'à deux selon votre département) et la possibilité de travailler jusqu'à deux semaines par an depuis l'étranger.

  • Une réelle autonomie, un terrain propice aux initiatives, ainsi que l'opportunité d'apporter votre expertise et de concrétiser vos meilleures idées.

  • Des espaces de travail accueillants avec un accès privilégié à une large sélection de thés biologiques et de superfoods du monde entier.

  • Nous aimons célébrer nos succès ensemble ! Événements réguliers, tea parties, fêtes de Noël et d'été, ainsi que diverses activations influenceurs (comme pour la Journée internationale des droits des femmes).

Postulez en envoyant votre CV et votre lettre de motivation - idéalement en anglais.

Engagement & Event Manager – Healthcare (all genders) - France (Paris)

Your role

As part of the French B2B team, you will be responsible for building and developing a strong and consistent experience for our healthcare professional network, particularly through congresses, events, training and other engagement opportunities.

You will work closely with the Regional Managers to identify opportunities and needs from the field and build an event strategy that maximizes the quality and impact of these interactions.

  • Define and lead the B2B acquisition and event experience strategy by identifying congresses, events, trainings, webinars and other opportunities to engage with healthcare professionals, and building an annual calendar aligned with the company’s objectives

  • Lead the organization and preparation of congresses and events, coordinating internal and external stakeholders to create a professional and consistent experience for participants

  • Develop experience and engagement formats tailored to healthcare professionals, including trainings, workshops, webinars, breakfasts and regional events, based on needs identified in the field

  • Maximize acquisition and conversion by working with Regional Managers to identify network activation needs, turning common needs into scalable initiatives and ensuring continuity between events, activation and follow-up

  • Build a differentiated healthcare professional experience by designing the professional journey before, during and after each event to strengthen engagement with Sunday Natural

  • Measure and optimize performance by analyzing attendance, lead quality, conversion, engagement and ROI to identify the highest-performing events and continuously improve our event strategy

Your profile

  • You have a scientific background or degree in nutrition, biology, healthcare or a similar field and you have initial experience in marketing, event or project management

  • You have a strong ability to understand and communicate scientific topics in an accessible way and feel comfortable discussing scientific subjects with different stakeholders

  • You are organized, autonomous and have strong project management and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple events and stakeholders simultaneously

  • You have a business-oriented mindset and are able to assess the relevance of opportunities, prioritize investments and measure their impact

  • You enjoy working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Brand and Product teams and are able to turn field needs into relevant and scalable experiences

  • Fluency in French and English (written and spoken)

Please note: As English is our company language, internal communication and initial interviews will take place in English.

What we offer

  • An appealing discount on all of our products – from essential oils to vitamins & nutrients

  • We offer 25 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

  • We believe great things happen when we meet in person, which is why we embrace a hybrid model with one home office day per week – up to two depending on the area you are working in – and up to two weeks per year working from abroad

  • You will be given real ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, as well as the opportunity to contribute your expertise and implement your great ideas

  • Inviting office spaces with access to plenty of organic teas and superfoods from around the world

  • We like to celebrate each other! Regular tea & office parties, Christmas and summer feasts and various influencer events such as Women's Day

Apply with your CV and cover letter.

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.
