Location:
Concept House, Brackenbeck Road, Bradford, BD7 2LW

Reports To:
Technical Manager

Salary
Salary is negotiable and will reflect the successful candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications.

Job Purpose

Debar designs and manufactures bifold door hardware and complete bifold door systems for customers in the UK and international markets. As we invest in future growth, new product development and the continued improvement of our existing product portfolio, we are creating a new Product Design Engineer position within our Technical Engineering team.

The primary focus of the role will be the ongoing engineering integrity, design improvement and evolution of Debar's released products. The successful candidate will investigate product issues, develop engineering solutions and lead the technical content of product changes.

While the principal focus will be existing products, the role will also contribute to larger product improvements and new development projects according to business priorities and team capacity.

Our products integrate precision mechanical hardware with aluminium profiles, requiring strong mechanical design judgement and an understanding of how changes can affect the performance of the wider bifold door system.

Key Responsibilities

Product Sustaining, Improvement & Engineering Change

  • Take technical design ownership of engineering issues and improvements relating to Debar's existing bifold hardware, systems and wider released product portfolio.
  • Investigate product failures, recurring issues, customer complaints and warranty matters, developing robust engineering solutions and corrective product improvements where required.
  • Redesign components and assemblies where required to improve performance, reliability, durability or cost.
  • Assess the wider impact of proposed changes on mating components, aluminium profiles and overall system performance.
  • Carry out tolerance analysis and tolerance stack-ups where required to resolve fit, function or performance issues.
  • Lead the engineering content of product change requests, ensuring changes are properly assessed, documented and progressed through Debar's engineering change process.
  • Create and update 3D CAD models, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, specifications and Bills of Materials associated with product changes.
  • Own and maintain the technical content of documentation for released products, including end-user, fabrication and installation manuals, technical bulletins and supporting product information.
  • Maintain accurate technical product data and configurations within relevant industry software, including Logikal, ensuring that approved profiles, hardware, rules and product changes are correctly reflected.
  • Support product changes arising from supplier changes, material changes, component availability, obsolescence or alternative manufacturing requirements.
  • Identify and progress opportunities for proactive product improvement and value engineering.

Testing, Technical Issues & Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with Debar's Compliance & Testing function to support testing or validation required as a result of product changes.
  • Support prototype components, trials and validation activity where required.
  • Liaise with customers, system partners and internal commercial teams on technical issues relating to existing products, investigating concerns and developing appropriate engineering solutions.
  • Work with suppliers on technical issues, alternative components, tooling changes and manufacturing feasibility.
  • Communicate the technical implications of product changes clearly to relevant internal and external stakeholders.

Product Development Support

  • Contribute to larger improvements and enhancements to Debar's existing bifold hardware and systems.
  • Support new product and system development projects according to business priorities and Technical Engineering resource requirements.
  • Work collaboratively with Product Development engineers on projects requiring shared expertise or additional capacity.

Person Specification

Essential Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Degree, HND or equivalent recognised higher-level qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design Engineering or a closely related discipline. A relevant formal qualification is mandatory.
  • Relevant professional experience in mechanical design, product design or product development engineering.
  • Strong capability in parametric 3D CAD and manufacturing-ready engineering drawings.
  • Experience designing and modifying physical products or components for manufacture.
  • Strong understanding of Design for Manufacture, dimensional tolerances, engineering fits and tolerance stack-up analysis.
  • Practical understanding of mechanical engineering, materials and relevant manufacturing processes.
  • Strong mechanical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to progress engineering work independently while collaborating effectively across different functions.

Particularly Valuable Experience

Experience in any of the following would be particularly valuable:

  • Fenestration, windows, doors, aluminium architectural systems or other moving door systems.
  • Mechanical or architectural hardware such as hinges, rollers, guides, handles or locks.
  • Small precision components involving aluminium extrusions, zinc or aluminium castings, mouldings or CNC-machined parts.
  • Product sustaining engineering, continuous product improvement or engineering change.
  • Failure investigation, corrective product redesign, value engineering or component substitution.
  • Product testing, validation, tooling or supplier development.
  • Autodesk Inventor is strongly preferred; experienced SolidWorks, Creo or comparable CAD users will also be considered. AutoCAD and ERP experience would be beneficial.
  • Producing controlled technical product documentation or maintaining product and configuration data within Logikal or comparable industry software.

Direct experience designing or improving bifold door hardware or systems would be particularly valuable but is not an essential requirement.

Attributes

The Mission

At Fyxer, we believe the only sustainable competitive advantage for a startup is the quality and speed of execution.

We are looking for a Product Lead who operates like a Staff PM: someone who owns our most important product bets end-to-end, from ambiguous problem space to shipped outcome. You combine sharp product judgment with hands-on discovery skills, and you measure yourself on commercial impact, not output.

We're not looking for someone to write specs and manage a backlog. We want someone who helps us think better, decide better, and ship better. The goal isn't more process, it's higher quality decisions made faster.

You will work directly with our Head of Product, CTO, founders and senior engineers to shape what we build and why.

What you will own

You will not hand anything over. You will own the bet from first insight to shipped impact.

  • Own discovery through delivery for our most important product bets, from early ambiguity to validated direction to launched product

  • Work directly with engineers and founders from the start of any initiative as the accountable product owner, not a coordinator

  • Frame the problem, define the hypothesis, and choose the fastest route to signal: interviews, prototypes, fake doors, experiments, or just shipping and measuring

  • Translate messy qualitative and quantitative signals into clear product direction, then drive that direction through to execution

  • Set success metrics, make the call on when there's enough signal to build, and own the outcome either way

  • Embed structured learning loops into how we operate so insight compounds over time

  • Raise the bar of product thinking across the team: coach others, introduce lightweight frameworks, and get the whole company closer to customers

Who you are

You are a full-stack product thinker.

  • Outcome owner: You connect user behaviour to funnels, retention, and revenue. You think in bets and expected value, not feature lists, and you hold yourself accountable to results.

  • Discovery-strong: Genuinely fluent across qualitative research, behavioural insight, and experimentation. You generate strong signal quickly and pick the right method for the decision at hand, rather than outsourcing the thinking.

  • Engineering partner: You work shoulder to shoulder with engineers, translating insight into crisp problem framing and practical tradeoffs. Engineers want to work with you because you make the work clearer, not slower.

  • Decision oriented: You know when there's enough signal to move. You sharpen hypotheses, clarify thinking, and make confident calls under uncertainty. You'd rather ship and learn than perfect and wait.

  • Force multiplier: Your impact shows up in how the whole team operates. You build repeatable systems for discovery and decision-making that outlast any single project.

The Role

You will be the senior product voice on our most important initiatives, working directly with the Head of Product, CPGO, founders, and senior engineers. This is not a support function. You will be embedded in high impact work from day one, with real authority over what we build and why.

You will operate at speed. We care about generating signal quickly, making informed decisions, and shipping fast. You are comfortable working with imperfect information and tightening your thinking as you go.

You will move fluidly across the full product lifecycle. Some weeks you will be deep in user interviews or pressure testing a major bet, other weeks you will be in the detail with engineers getting something over the line.

You will have significant autonomy. We expect strong judgment, clear communication, and ownership of outcomes.

If there are specific tools you believe are critical to moving faster or generating better signal, we will support that. We want you to design the right setup, not work around constraints.

Why Fyxer?

We are intentional about our team. We believe a small, exceptional team working with extreme focus will always outperform a large, bloated organization.

  • Velocity: You will be fast-tracked into senior responsibilities far earlier than at a traditional company.

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We're hiring our first dedicated legal operations team member to sit at the heart of 9fin's growing Legal Affairs function. This is a broad, hands-on role and a rare opportunity to shape how a scale-up in-house legal team runs from the inside out.

You'll own the operational engine of the team: our contract lifecycle platform (Ironclad, which is deeply embedded across sales, procurement and RevOps), our commercial playbook (and developing non-commercial playbooks), our tech stack (including AI implementation), our front-door (right now, ticketing is done in Linear), our knowledge management (currently spread across multiple systems), our reporting and KPIs, and the tracking and governance around outside counsel spend.

You'll also be a project manager and a hands-on partner to the General Counsel. That includes co-drafting monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading and coordinating cross-functional initiatives (for example M&A diligence coordination, trademark portfolio work, or regulatory readiness workstreams), and holding a high bar for organisation so nothing on a small, fast-moving team drops.

You'll report to the General Counsel and work alongside legal colleagues in London and New York. This is a London-based role and we typically expect the team to be in the office three days a week.

What you’ll work on

Below is the shape of the role, laid out as prioritised by Now, Next and Later so you can see the broad strokes of the path ahead - but by no means is this set in stone. Priorities will move as we learn what's most useful in practice and you’ll have a big hand in shaping this further.

Now

  • Tune legal intake - help us build out the “front door” for legal requests across the business.

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, InfoSec and Procurement to streamline deal-desk and approval processes

  • Support on knowledge management and internal policy administration. Consolidate knowledge, templates, and other information in a clean accessible structure.

  • Build our external legal spend tracker from scratch. Categorise spend, log invoices and quotes, match to matter, and produce a monthly view for the General Counsel.

  • Own KPI reporting improvements against our Ironclad-fed dashboards. Expand coverage into intake, spend, cycle times, and other operational metrics.

  • Own operational and reporting support across the Legal function, including responses to internal stakeholders including Finance, RevOps, and the People team.

Next

  • Get inside and own our tech stack and know it end-to-end - Ironclad, Linear, Google Workspace, Notion, and the AI tools we've adopted or are evaluating.

  • Build, maintain and roll out templates, playbooks and self-serve legal resources so the business can move quickly.

  • Own Ironclad workflow hygiene and adoption end-to-end. Work with the team to clean up metadata and archiving, tighten approvals and signatory workflows, and work with commercial counsel to roll out training across sales, procurement, RevOps and other frequent users.

  • Bring structure and visibility across the team. Keep track of open projects, drive follow-through, and make sure balls do not drop across a small team with a lot of surface area.

  • Maintain our sales contract playbook. Keep it current, propose updates as commercial patterns and RevOps feedback surface them, and make sure the team is actually using it.

Later

We're looking for a senior employment attorney to help lead our Employment Legal function as we scale internationally. An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You're joining our Product Marketing team that owns product positioning, launch strategy, and market adoption for Primer's core product lines. We operate as strategic partners embedded in each major domain, working alongside Product and Sales leadership to define how our products win in market. Our PMMs own end-to-end strategy and execution for a significant product area, which means your work gets seen, shaped, and acted on by senior leadership from day one. You'll report to our Product Marketing Lead and work directly with product leads, marketing leads and senior stakeholders across the business.

What will you be doing?

  • Build the partner marketing engine end-to-end in collaboration with the Product Marketing Lead, delivering messaging assets and post-launch reporting

  • Collaborate closely with the marketing and product teams to build product positioning, value propositions, and messaging for partner features, ensuring they roll out consistently in market

  • Collaborate with the marketing and partner teams to produce impactful campaigns for our partner ecosystem

  • Collect and analyze market insights to update and refine customer/persona journeys for targeted marketing.

  • Report on how your initiatives perform - adoption, engagement, and activation - on an agreed cadence

  • Write campaign assets, briefs, and enablement material, adapting them across channels without needing a new template each time.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 2-3 years of B2B SaaS marketing or product marketing experience, having owned go-to-market launches end to end.

  • Comfort turning technical product detail into messaging that actually lands with a technical buyer or partner, not just a simplified summary

  • A skilled communicator with expertise in writing, storytelling, and creating engaging content across multiple channels and formats

  • A motivated team player who is humble, ambitious, and eager to drive impact - someone who wants ownership over their work rather than executing a brief

Nice-to-haves:

  • Background in payments (a big plus!), fintech or a marketplace with deep understanding on how the industry works

  • Experience marketing a two-sided marketplace, balancing supply-side and demand-side value props

You may not like it here

  • You'll be building infrastructure as much as writing copy, so there's no established process to lean on yet

  • The roadmap is still forming, so your priorities may shift as things evolve

  • This role blends strategy and execution, so you'll want to be comfortable doing both

  • It's a highly collaborative role, so it suits someone who enjoys working closely across teams rather than independently

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Senior Compliance Director – UK to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Senior Compliance Director – UK will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋

Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly.

This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them.

In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets.

  • Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention.

  • Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio.

  • Establish AI-native ways of working across the team - embedding modern tooling, setting standards for how AI accelerates discovery, delivery, and decision-making, and ensuring the team operates at the leading edge of product practice.

  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Commercial Finance to deliver scalable, reliable distribution products that meet the needs of TMCs, OBTs, and other partners.

  • Represent Product in commercial and partner discussions, acting as a credible voice on capability, roadmap, and strategic direction with senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Drive a culture of clear prioritisation, evidence-based decisions, and continuous improvement - ensuring the team is always working on what matters most.

We'd love to hear from you if you have... 🔍

  • Significant experience in a senior product leadership role, with ownership of strategy, delivery, and commercial outcomes for partner-facing products.

  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, with the ability to set high standards and build team capability over time.

  • Commercial acumen and confidence working closely with Sales and Account Management organisations, with a clear understanding of how product decisions connect to revenue and retention.

  • Experience owning or contributing to a P&L, with the ability to translate financial performance into clear product priorities.

  • A hands-on approach to AI - you use it in your own work and understand how to embed it meaningfully into team workflows and product processes, ideally with experience setting AI-native standards across a product organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across Engineering, Commercial, Finance, and UX at a senior level.

  • Ideally, experience working with distribution platforms, APIs, or partner-facing technology in a travel, transport, or similarly complex B2B environment.

  • Helpful if you have experience navigating the dynamics of enterprise partner relationships, balancing bespoke client needs with scalable platform thinking.

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 

  • 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As a Senior Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you'll help drive offensive security at Docker, putting our products, platforms, and cloud infrastructure under realistic adversarial testing to surface and drive out attack paths before real adversaries find them. You'll partner with engineering, product, and leadership to turn findings into durable fixes and to shape how security is designed into every Docker product.

You'll apply your expertise in penetration testing, threat modeling, and exploit development to find and eliminate risks across Docker products and infrastructure. Working across cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), containerized environments, and AI/ML products, you'll implement proactive security solutions that scale with Docker's growth.

This role offers the opportunity to help improve security programs at a company whose products are trusted by millions of developers worldwide. You'll work in a fast-paced, technically challenging environment where your security expertise directly impacts both Docker's platform and the broader container ecosystem.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to security initiatives that align with business goals, helping ensure security is a core component of our products and infrastructure

  • Support and help implement key security programs such as automated security design reviews, and vulnerability management

  • Build deep knowledge of software security and architecture, and act as a go-to resource for engineering teams

  • Partner with engineering to design and implement security architecture and controls across Docker products and platforms

  • Plan, scope, and execute penetration tests and red-team / adversary-emulation engagements against Docker's products and services

  • Develop proof-of-concept exploits and produce clear, risk-rated findings with actionable remediation guidance, then retest fixes to confirm closure

  • Build and maintain offensive security tooling and automation to expand testing coverage and repeatability

  • Perform security reviews and threat modeling (design, architecture, and code) across Docker products and services, including emerging AI products, and write automated security tests and exploits

  • Serve on rotating on-call schedule to respond to security events, investigate threats, and coordinate remediation efforts

  • Educate and collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, product) to promote security practices

  • Participate in Security Incident response

Qualifications

  • Have 3+ years in security engineering, including hands-on offensive security and penetration testing across applications and infrastructure

  • Possess 2+ years of hands-on development experience in Python or Golang

  • Demonstrate deep expertise in authentication, authorization, including technologies like OAuth, cryptography applications and Zero Trust principles.

  • Have strong hands-on experience with securing cloud ecosystems (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Have hands-on penetration testing experience across SaaS web applications and APIs., including manual exploitation beyond automated scanners

  • Are proficient with offensive tooling and techniques such as. Burp Suite, and OWASP frameworks

  • Can write security tests and develop exploits and proof-of-concepts that find real vulnerabilities in a product

  • Understand AI/ML security risks and mitigations, including prompt injection, data poisoning, model extraction, and adversarial attacks

  • Have practical experience using LLMs and agentic tooling to automate vulnerability discovery, reconnaissance, and pentesting workflows

  • Have a track record of building security programs and automations from scratch, applying risk-based prioritization

  • Have experience performing security reviews and building or improving security review automation

  • Have excellent communication skills, allowing you to explain complex security concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Understand industry standards, and actively keep up with emerging security technologies and models

  • Are a team player who drives security change via collaboration and cross-functional partnerships

  • Hold offensive security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CRTO

  • Have published CVEs, original security research, or conference talks

Bonus if you:

  • Have experience with container escape, Kubernetes attack paths, or cloud red teaming

  • Have experience testing AI/ML systems for issues like prompt injection, model extraction, and data poisoning

What to Expect

First 30 days:

  • Meet with security team and key partners across engineering

  • Gain access to team owned systems, and internal documentation

  • Complete security awareness training and compliance onboarding

  • Review application architecture, tech stack and data flow

  • Review risk registry and annual roadmap

  • Familiarize oneself with team workflows and processes

  • Shadow a fellow security engineer during their on-call/secops rotations

First 90 days:

  • Conduct security review on emerging Docker products

  • Scope and execute your first penetration test against a Docker product or service

  • Actively participate in architecture design reviews with the team

  • Contribute to a Security-owned project or initiative

  • Collaborate with Docker developers to validate and resolve discovered vulnerabilities

  • Enhance incident response capabilities by participating in on-call rotation and post-incident activities

  • Create and maintain security documentation and runbooks

First Year Outlook

  • Contribute to the security roadmap for improving security controls

  • Strengthen Zero Trust architecture and least privilege access controls

  • Enhance security monitoring and anomaly detection

  • Perform security reviews for major product releases

  • Own and run recurring penetration tests and adversary-emulation exercises across Docker products, and engage with external researchers

  • Support audits and ensure compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27xxx

  • Advocate for “security by design” in all product features

  • Become well versed in Docker products and emerging AI technologies

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

 

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

What you'll actually do

  • Grow and manage our broker panel, bringing on new brokers and training them to properly understand and sell our products

  • Build real relationships with existing brokers, the kind that make them think of you first when a deal comes up

  • Review referrals and provide sense checks and indicative offers, reading business financials well enough to spot what matters

  • Own your portfolio end to end, converting referral volume into funded deals, not just noise in the pipeline

  • Represent Wayflyer at industry events and in broker networks, building our name as much as your own

What this role could turn into

Brokers are a key focus area for the business, so whoever takes this on gets a real say in shaping it, not just executing someone else's plan. From here, that can mean leading a regional broker team as we expand into new regions, or stepping into a wider commercial partnerships role across the business.

Who thrives here

Someone who treats brokers as partners, not leads, and understands that a broker's reputation is on the line every time they refer you a deal. You're commercially sharp, comfortable with numbers, and genuinely curious about the businesses behind the applications, not just the credit markers. You don't wait for a case to be handed to you in a tidy format. You chase it down, sense-check it, and move.

We hire for range

We're looking for someone who's spent at least 2 years in business lending, ideally in fintech, and at least 2 years working directly with commercial finance brokers, with a real network to show for it. You'll have at least a year analysing business financials at a working level, and Hubspot experience is a bonus. More important than the years is the trajectory: have you built something, grown a book, or turned relationships into revenue? We'll also consider exceptional candidates from adjacent areas of business finance who don't tick every box.

Location and working policy

📍London, hybrid (3-4 days)

 

The good stuff

25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

data.description:
The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and building products that establish trust in cryptocurrencies. We are a global organization that thrives on challenging work and doing it alongside exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry evolves rapidly, and our mission is to build a flexible, AI-driven platform that helps organizations investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and participate in the cryptocurrency ecosystem with confidence.

Platform Engineering provides the shared infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience layer that powers every engineering team at Chainalysis. The team is evolving toward consolidated, scalable platform patterns that support global growth, improve reliability, and reduce the operational burden on product engineers. We partner closely with Developer Productivity, Information Security, Cost Optimization, and R&D teams to provide secure, self-service paths from development through production.

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the foundational services that enable Chainalysis engineers to deliver and run software safely. You will own complex technical work from inception through production, influence platform standards and roadmaps, and help create systems that are highly available, observable, secure, and easy for other engineers to use.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve highly available platform services, including managed Kubernetes clusters, Kafka, CI/CD systems, artifact management, and related shared infrastructure

  • Build secure, scalable infrastructure across AWS and other cloud environments using infrastructure as code and repeatable automation

  • Improve production reliability through well-defined SLOs, graceful degradation, self-healing, automated recovery, and effective incident response

  • Create self-service workflows and platform abstractions that reduce cognitive load and help R&D teams ship and operate software more effectively

  • Partner with Information Security, Cost Optimization, and engineering teams to strengthen controls, improve cloud efficiency, influence technical direction, and contribute to the platform roadmap

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Deep experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting production infrastructure in AWS, including services such as IAM, EC2, EKS, RDS, MSK, S3, Lambda, VPC, and networking

  • Experience administering and scaling multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters and streaming platforms such as Kafka in production, including upgrades, workload isolation, reliability, security, and incident response

  • Experience building and maintaining infrastructure as code, pipeline-as-code, containerization, and cloud-native systems using tools such as Terraform, Helm, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, or Kubernetes

  • Experience designing observability for production systems and tuning relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, using tools such as Datadog or Prometheus

  • Strong software-engineering or scripting skills in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, Scala, or shell, plus a track record of owning ambiguous cross-functional problems and communicating tradeoffs clearly

You might also have:

  • Experience with elevating developer productivity and the developer experience

  • Experience building self-service tooling or reusable platform abstractions for engineering teams

  • Interest in cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology, or curiosity and willingness to learn

  • Experience operating in a security standards-compliant environment such as ISO 27001, NIST 800-171, or SOC 2

Technologies we use:

AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Helm, Ansible, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Artifactory, Backstage, Datadog, Prometheus, PostgreSQL, and Python

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. As a Senior Software Engineer on Camunda's new Data Streaming team, you'll help build a foundational new piece of architecture that changes how customers and internal products access process data. Today, customers have no first-class way to stream their own process data out of Camunda into their own systems. You'll be part of a greenfield team building a durable, continuously-written streaming layer that decouples data consumption entirely from the live engine. You'll be part of a small team from day one, responsible not only for the streaming architecture itself, but also the analytics product and other data consumers built on top of it - with real room to shape both the architecture and the team's scope as it matures. You will play a key part in shaping the architecture in a genuinely exciting and fast-paced domain.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, the Data Layer and Distributed Systems teams, QA, and support, and work closely with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data streaming architecture evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Design and build the core streaming infrastructure that decouples process data access from the live execution engine, backed by durable, low-cost storage.

  • Build customer-facing data streaming capabilities, including a supported way to integrate with systems like Kafka, so customers can reliably get their process data into their own tools.

  • Help rebuild how Camunda's analytics product consumes and serves process data at scale, moving it off the engine's critical path entirely.

  • Make foundational architecture decisions as part of a small, high-ownership team, including how the system guarantees consistency and durability across a distributed streaming pipeline.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. 

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  7+ years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on distributed or data-intensive systems.

  • Hands-on experience with object storage systems (S3/GCS/Azure or similar) and building reliable, idempotent upload/commit protocols against them.

  • Experience with Kafka or a similar streaming/event-log system.

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems fundamentals, even without core execution-engine experience specifically.

  • A demonstrated track record of driving a technical initiative through genuine ambiguity in a still-being-designed system, not just extending an established one.

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end, from solution design, project planning, and coordinating across teams, right through to driving predictable delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Apache Iceberg, Parquet, or general lakehouse/data-lake architectures.

  • Experience with embedded state stores (RocksDB or similar) for projection/checkpointing workloads.

  • Experience with stream processing frameworks (e.g. Apache Flink), particularly stateful processing with local state backends and checkpointing.

  • Familiarity with object-storage-native streaming architectures (e.g. systems like WarpStream) is a plus, even without direct hands-on experience.

As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.

As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.

  • Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience working with both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.

  • Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Mission Principale :
 
En tant qu'Account Executive SMB, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de notre portefeuille clients en traitant l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la qualification des leads entrants jusqu’au closing.
 
Votre focus sera les leads entrants non identifiés dans notre CRM, en dehors des sociétés déjà connues de notre base de données. Vous aurez pour objectif de transformer ces opportunités en contrats clients.
 
 
Responsabilités :
 
1. Gestion du cycle de vente intégral :
- Qualification des leads entrants : Identifier et prioriser les leads générés par le marketing ou d'autres canaux, avec un focus sur les entreprises SMB (1 à 5 juristes).
- Compréhension des besoins clients : Mener des découvertes approfondies et efficaces pour comprendre les défis et besoins spécifiques des prospects afin de proposer la solution la plus adaptée.
- Présentation des solutions : Démonstration de notre plateforme SaaS et de ses fonctionnalités en lien avec les enjeux des prospects.
- Négociation et closing : Gérer la proposition de valeur, négocier les termes du contrat et finaliser les ventes jusqu'à la signature.
 
2. Suivi des opportunités commerciales :
- Utilisation proactive du CRM pour tenir à jour les opportunités, le pipeline de vente, et assurer un suivi rigoureux des prospects.
- Priorisation des opportunités les plus chaudes
- Participer aux réunions hebdomadaires de revue du pipeline
 
3. Collaboration interservices :
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Produit et Customer Success pour assurer une excellente expérience client.
- Remonter les feedbacks des prospects et clients pour améliorer le produit et les processus commerciaux.
 
4. Développement de la connaissance marché :
- Maintenir une veille active sur les évolutions du secteur juridique et des besoins spécifiques des entreprises juridiques SMB.
- Proposer des initiatives pour améliorer la qualification des leads et les stratégies de vente sur ce segment de marché.
 
Objectifs et KPIs :
- Honorer un nombre de volume rdvs journaliers issus de la qualification de leads entrants.
- Taux de conversion des leads entrants en opportunités qualifiées.
- Allier qualité et opportunisme dans traitement des salescycle pour convertir avec le meilleur Sales Cycle.
- Atteinte des quotas de vente mensuels et trimestriels.

Compétences requises :
  • Expérience commerciale : Expérience significative en tant qu’Account Executive, Business Developer ou poste similaire, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS ou dans la vente de solutions B2B.
  • Cycle de vente complet : Capacité prouvée à gérer un cycle de vente de bout en bout (qualification, négociation, closing).
  • Orienté résultats : Forte capacité à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs de vente, avec un excellent sens des priorités.
  • Communication : Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec des interlocuteurs variés.

    • Qualités personnelles :
  • Autonomie et proactivité : Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement startup en forte croissance.
  • Écoute active : Vous êtes à l’écoute des besoins de vos interlocuteurs et savez adapter votre discours en conséquence.
  • Esprit d'équipe : Vous aimez collaborer avec les autres départements pour atteindre des objectifs communs.
  • Adaptabilité : Vous êtes flexible et capable de vous adapter rapidement aux changements dans un environnement en constante évolution.
  • Résilience : Vous avez une forte capacité à surmonter les obstacles et à persévérer pour atteindre vos objectifs.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

In this role, you will work closely with the finance team to ensure fraud risks are managed effectively.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Global payments are complex and ever-evolving. At Checkout our software engineers develop the next-generation payments technologies that enable our Merchants to boost their acceptance rates, cut processing costs, fight fraud, and create cutting edge technology that enables extraordinary customer experiences.

We're looking for Software engineers who bring fresh ideas, have a curious nature and are passionate about working in an Engineering environment which focuses on building products to achieve the company's strategic goals. You’ll get to work with teams from across Checkout.com’s portfolio of products and services who all have a real customer first philosophy.

As a Software engineer, you will lead and drive specific projects critical to Checkout's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display exceptional leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. With your technical expertise you will lead project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

What are we looking for:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Proficiency in C# .NET, Java, or Go, with a strong understanding of software development principles in either a backend or full stack environment.

  • Great communication skills and ability to interact effectively with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Experience working in agile environments and delivering high-quality code within tight deadlines

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team

  • Someone who is AI proficient or AI curious, you will be hungry to embrace what the latest technology has to offer to enhance yours and your teams productivity

  • Payments or financial knowledge is a plus, but not a necessity



How you’ll make an impact

  • Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.

  • Define and design loosely coupled, scalable systems in a wider microservices using industry best practices.

  • Stay up-to-date, use, and spread knowledge of the latest technologies used by Checkout.

  • Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.

  • Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.

  • Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français.

 

L'opportunité :

Pour accompagner notre hypercroissance en France, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Regional Manager pour Paris et l'Île-de-France. Ce poste est un véritable rôle de "Player-Coach".

Tu auras la responsabilité de structurer, d'encadrer et faire grandir notre force de frappe commerciale.

Les 6 premiers mois seront axés sur une présence terrain très forte pour ouvrir la voie et structurer la région. Tu maintiendras ensuite cet ancrage opérationnel pour piloter par l'exemple et rester au plus près de la réalité du terrain.

 

Tes Missions :

  • Management & Leadership : Tu encadres, animes et coaches au quotidien une équipe composée de Team Leads et de Représentants Commerciaux. Tu les accompagnes régulièrement sur le terrain pour les faire monter en compétences et dépasser leurs objectifs.

  • Business Development (100% Hands-on) : Tu montres l'exemple ! Particulièrement lors de tes 6 premiers mois, tu enfiles ta casquette de chasseur pour prospecter, faire des démos et closer des deals de façon autonome. Tu garderas ton propre pipeline de ventes par la suite pour rester connecté(e) à la réalité du terrain.

  • Stratégie & Pilotage : Tu es le/la garant(e) des résultats de la région parisienne. Tu définis la stratégie locale, pilotes les KPIs, mets en place les plans d'action nécessaires et assures un reporting précis à la direction.

  • Recrutement & Structuration : Tu participes activement au recrutement de tes futurs talents et garantis une intégration (onboarding) réussie pour bâtir la meilleure équipe de vente d'Île-de-France.

  • Ambassadeur/drice Salonkee : Tu représentes notre marque sur le marché parisien, en créant des relations de confiance durables avec les gérants de salons, les grands comptes et les partenaires clés.


Ton Profil :

  • Leader inspirant : Tu as une expérience confirmée et réussie dans le management d'équipes commerciales.

  • Tempérament chasseur & "Hands-on" : Tu n'es pas un(e) manager de bureau. Tu as le goût du challenge, l'âme d'un(e) vrai(e) vendeur(se) et tu n'as pas peur de prendre ton téléphone ou de pousser la porte d'un salon.

  • Expérience Sales B2B : Tu as un solide historique de performance en vente terrain B2B, de préférence dans l'univers du SaaS ou dans un environnement très rythmé.

  • Autonomie & Organisation : Véritable self-starter, tu sais planifier ta stratégie régionale tout en jonglant avec tes propres rendez-vous clients.

  • Digital Native : Tu es très à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech : la maîtrise d'un CRM moderne est indispensable pour bien piloter ton activité.

  • Mobilité : Le permis B est indispensable. Tu sillonneras la région parisienne au quotidien.

  • Langues : Français natif. Un anglais professionnel est vivement souhaité pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

 

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Un package salarial attractif (Fixe solide + Bonus non plafonné récompensant tes propres ventes ET celles de ton équipe).

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage.

  • Organisation autonome : tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance.

  • Mutuelle

  • Tickets-restaurant

  • 25 jours de congés + repos supplémentaire (sous conditions).

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story européenne et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'expansion de Salonkee en France.

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer l'esprit d'équipe.

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.


Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

Must Have

Step into a role where science meets strategy and your expertise shapes the future of drug development. As a Director, Pharmacometrician, you’ll lead high-impact modeling and simulation efforts within a dynamic Clinical Pharmacology, Modeling and Simulation (CPMS) environment. You’ll guide teams, mentor pharmacometricians, and provide strategic insight to clients at key development milestones. This role also offers the opportunity to represent clients in interactions with regulatory agencies. If you thrive on collaboration and solving complex scientific challenges, this is your chance to make a meaningful impact.

About the role

This role combines scientific leadership and strategic impact, leading population PK analyses while developing innovative approaches to improve efficiency and accuracy. You will design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies, provide strategic guidance to clients, and contribute to regulatory documents and agency interactions. In addition, you’ll foster client relationships, support business development, and stay at the forefront of PK/PD advancements to drive continuous improvement.

Your main responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Lead and conduct population PK analyses using advanced modeling tools and methodologies
  • Develop and implement innovative approaches to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of PK analysis
  • Design, analyze, and interpret clinical pharmacology studies (renal, hepatic, TQT, ADME, DDI, BE/BA, SAD, MAD, etc.) and provide guidance to optimize pharmacokinetic sampling and dosing strategies  
  • Provide strategic guidance to clients, owning deliverables and developing clinical pharmacology plans
  • Author and review PK reports and clinical pharmacology sections of regulatory documents
  • Represent clients in regulatory interactions and contribute to business development and relationship management

Requirements

About You

If you are a driven clinical pharmacology professional with 6–10 years of experience in drug development and pharmacometrics and you bring sharp analytical thinking and expertise in tools like NONMEM, Pirana, and R to deliver high-impact insights while being client-focused and a natural leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, combining strategic thinking, strong communication, and business acumen to build relationships and drive results, this role is for you.

To be successful we are looking for the following traits and behaviors:

  • Life science, healthcare and/or business degree 
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant work experience, including experience in drug development, clinical pharmacology, and pharmacometrics 
  • Regulatory experience including regulatory report writing essential. Experience with regulatory submissions including INDs, CTAs, regulatory meetings and NDA/BLA/MAA submissions
  • Proficiency in NONMEM, Pirana, and R software preferred 
  • Excellent organizational, negotiating and financial skills 

Benefits

About Allucent

Our mission is to help bring new therapies to light. When you work at Allucent, that means rolling up your sleeves and applying your unique skill set, expertise, and knowledge to build partnerships with our clients in their pursuit to develop new, life-improving treatments.

 

If you're passionate about helping customers develop new pharmaceuticals and biologics; have an entrepreneurial spirit; and ready to join other science, business, and operations leaders, we would love to get to learn more about how we can help each other grow.

Benefits of working at Allucent include:

Apply now!
